o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish دفنی (defni), from Greek δάφνη (dáfni).
Likely a calque of Persian خجالت کشیدن (xajâlat kešidan).
Borrowed from Russian фармакотерапия (farmakoterapija). By surface analysis, farmako- + terapiya.
